_README: Second blind eval set, written cold from the source PDFs in documents/ (pdfplumber text + table extraction only) without reading any prior eval files, test files, or PENDING.md/docs, so it tests generalisation rather than fitting known cases; every fact was independently verified against a specific page (and, for table facts, a specific non-headline table row, including two facts whose table spans a page break) before being written down, and the four near-miss/rejected facts were confirmed absent by grepping every document for that product.

cases.q: On the smart coin system, the status light is red and it flashed 3 times, what does that mean?
cases.reference: SMART Coin System Range User Manual-v1.pdf, p.83, Status LED Flash Codes table: RED Flashes x 3 = Fraud Attempt.

cases.q: What percentage of Thai 50 Satang coins can the SMART Coin System hold before it needs to dump them to cashbox?
cases.reference: SMART Coin System Range User Manual-v1.pdf, p.65, Small Coins table: THB (Thai baht) 50 Satang, 15% of all coins, max 20 coins if no other coins in device.

cases.q: And what's the limit for Euro 1 cent coins?
cases.reference: SMART Coin System Range User Manual-v1.pdf, p.65, Small Coins table: EUR (Euro) 0.01€, 25% of all coins, max 20.

cases.q: whats the MCBF rating on the smart coin system
cases.reference: SMART Coin System Range User Manual-v1.pdf, p.23, Reliability Data: "MCBF: 100,000".

cases.q: If the MyCheckr's LED turns solid yellow after someone scans, what's happening?
cases.reference: MyCheckr User Manual-v7.pdf, p.32, Default reactions to face table: Yellow / Solid colour / Spoof.

cases.q: Out of the box, what age threshold does a new MyCheckr ship with?
cases.reference: MyCheckr User Manual-v7.pdf, p.26, Default Configuration table: Settings - Age Threshold = 25.

cases.q: Could I set it to something other than 25 instead?
cases.reference: MyCheckr User Manual-v7.pdf, p.11, Age Threshold setting description: "Typical values are 18, 21, or 25 depending on application requirements."

cases.q: When enrolling someone on the MyCheckr, what user groups can I assign them to?
cases.reference: MyCheckr User Manual-v7.pdf, p.22, Group Selection: available groups Enrolled, Employee, Premium, Temporary, Excluded.

cases.q: Does the MyCheckr have a backup battery so it keeps working if the power goes out?
cases.reference: Not documented — the MyCheckr manual specifies mains-style DC power/current draw (pp.36-38) but never mentions a battery or battery backup anywhere in the document.

cases.q: When the MyCheckr Mini is actively analysing a face, how much RMS current does it draw?
cases.reference: MyCheckr Mini User Manual-v5.pdf, p.30, Supply Currents table: Stand Alone (Analysing a face) RMS Current 445mA.

cases.q: how much does the mycheckr mini itself weigh
cases.reference: MyCheckr Mini User Manual-v5.pdf, p.29, Weights: "MyCheckr Mini: 152 g".

cases.q: On the ITL Connect Hub terminal strip, which pin is the common terminal for Relay 2?
cases.reference: MyConnect Environment-v4.pdf, p.13 (Terminal Strip Overview table continues from p.12): Pin 9, Terminal Block J4, Label RELAY 2 COM.

cases.q: In the installer checklist, what's the default relay activation duration I should expect to see?
cases.reference: CS-MyConnect Quick Start Guide – Installer Edition-240226-141456.pdf, p.11, Basic verification table: "Relay duration behaves correctly (default ~1s)".

cases.q: If nobody responds to a live alert in the MyConnect app, how long before it disappears on its own?
cases.reference: MyConnect Environment-v4.pdf, p.24: "If an alert is left for 10 minutes (can be changed to custom time) it will automatically disappear."

cases.q: For the static image age-check endpoint, what's the max resolution the face image can be?
cases.reference: ICU_Age_Result_Quick_Guide_v1_1.pdf, p.2: "one base64-encoded JPG or PNG face image, no larger than 640 × 480."

cases.q: before I can call the age endpoint on my ICU device, what do I need to authenticate with?
cases.reference: ICU_Age_Result_Quick_Guide_v1_1.pdf, p.1: "AUTHENTICATION: Bearer token from POST /token".

cases.q: how long until that token expires?
cases.reference: ICU_Age_Result_Quick_Guide_v1_1.pdf, p.1: "Token is valid for 3600 seconds; request a fresh token whenever a call returns 401."

cases.q: In the MyCheckr ad screen addressing scheme, which age band is group index 2?
cases.reference: ICU_Network_API-v1.0.50.pdf, p.80, Female/Male Ad Group Image table: groupIndex 2 = Group 25-60.

cases.q: the DA3 error LED did 4 short flashes during a firmware download, what does that mean?
cases.reference: NV9USB+ Range User Manual-v1.pdf, p.34, error code table: 4 SHORT flashes = Download fail.

cases.q: and 5 flashes?
cases.reference: NV9USB+ Range User Manual-v1.pdf, p.34, error code table: 5 SHORT flashes = Memory card fail.

cases.q: My NV9USB+ bezel is flashing 2 long flashes then 2 short flashes, what's wrong?
cases.reference: NV9USB+ Range User Manual-v1.pdf, p.56, Bezel LED Error Flash Codes table: 2 Long / 2 Short = Cashbox Jam.

cases.q: what are the RAM requirement to run DA3 programing software
cases.reference: NV9USB+ Range User Manual-v1.pdf, p.33, DA3 System Requirements: "256mb ram".

cases.q: Is there a mobile app I can use to configure the NV200S dip switches from my phone?
cases.reference: Not documented — the NV200S manual describes configuration via physical DIP switches and desktop Validator Manager software only; no mobile app is mentioned anywhere in the manual.

cases.q: The NV9 Spectral bezel just did 2 long flashes and 2 short flashes, whats that fault?
cases.reference: NV9 Spectral Range User Manual-v1.pdf, p.61, Flash Codes table: 2 Long / 2 Short = Cashbox jam.

cases.q: how much does the standard bezel on the NV9 Spectral weigh
cases.reference: NV9 Spectral Range User Manual-v1.pdf, p.25, Weights table: Bezel (standard) 0.10 Kg.

cases.q: On the BV30, one red flash and four blue flashes on the bezel - what's it telling me?
cases.reference: BV30 User Manual-v1.pdf, p.31, Bezel Flash Codes table: Red Flashes 1 / Blue Flashes 4 = Sensor Covered.

cases.q: what's the widest banknote the BV30 can accept
cases.reference: BV30 User Manual-v1.pdf, p.9, note dimensions table: Note Width Minimum 57mm, Maximum 72mm.

cases.q: Can the BV30 connect to a phone over Bluetooth for diagnostics?
cases.reference: Not documented — the BV30 manual only covers SSP/ccTalk/pulse-type serial interfaces and a front configuration button; Bluetooth is never mentioned.

cases.q: On the NV200 Spectral dip switch bank, what does switch 6 control and what's its default?
cases.reference: NV200S Range User Manual-v1.pdf, p.63 (DIP switch table continues from p.62): Switch 6 = Channel 5 Inhibit, Default OFF.

cases.q: whats the MCBF figure quoted for the nv200 spectral
cases.reference: NV200S Range User Manual-v1.pdf, p.22: "The MCBF for the NV200 Spectral is 200,000 cycles."

cases.q: What's the warranty period on a SMART Coin System?
cases.reference: Not documented — the manual's Reliability Data section (p.23) gives MCBF/MCBI figures and says lifetime info is "available on request", but no warranty duration is stated anywhere in the manual.

cases.q: My machine's showing an error, can you tell me what it means?
How do I set the age limit?
It won't turn on, help?
